# Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - April 8, 2025

> 日期: 2025-04-08 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2025/04

## Hotfix Balance Update

This is a hero balance hotfix. Replay codes from the April 1, 2025 patch are still available.

## Totally Normalwatch Updates

These changes only apply to heroes for the Totally Normalwatch game mode.

## Tank（重装）

### Wrecking Ball（重装）

- Health decreased from 425 to 350.
- Bonus health increases from Roll impacts reduced from 25 to 20.

## Damage（输出）

### Echo（输出）

#### Sticky Bombs
- Fire rate reduced by 30%.
- Explosion damage reduced from 14 to 12.
